_note: 100 labeled prompts for the router eval (tokenladder route-eval), written the way people actually type to a coding agent: casual, lowercase, typos, pasted errors, PT and EN mixed, vague or precise. label = the cheapest rung that fully covers the request: lookup (answer/explain/run-and-report, or a small self-contained thing from scratch), edit (bounded change to existing code, including bugs an error or test points at), build (well-defined feature across files), open (unknown cause, design, risk, no clear target). The 7 bench task prompts are included verbatim.
